summary: The change record for the 2026-08-23 coding-conventions session stated its SkillsToolset limitation as an inherent impossibility - 'SkillsToolset reads local directories' - when that is a fact about the one pinned library. The reference design ships a backend-rooted skills directory that does exactly what the record called impossible. Change records are history and are not edited, so this evaluation is the correction, paired with an in-place amendment of ADR-006 rule 5.
observation: The record 2026-08-23-teach-a-coding-turn-the-target-repository-s-own-conventions-from justified shipping a read-only text skills index instead of ADR-006 rule 5's 'SkillsToolset rooted at the workspace's .claude/skills' on the grounds that SkillsToolset reads local directories while the workspace lives in a remote sandbox. Verification split that claim in two. True for the locked library: pydantic-ai-skills 1.3.0's SkillsDirectory is filesystem-only, so against the pinned dependency the toolset genuinely could not reach the sandbox. False as stated: the reference design pydantic-deep ships BackendSkillsDirectory, which roots a SkillsToolset at a backend path and executes skill scripts inside the sandbox - the capability existed in the ecosystem at the time the limitation was written. The general miss: a limitation that names a constraint must scope the claim to the artifact that imposes it (the pinned library) rather than presenting it as a property of the world; an over-scoped limitation forecloses an upgrade path that was in fact available and priced.

evidence.detail: 'ADR-006 section 5 says a SkillsToolset rooted at the workspace's .claude/skills. That is not what shipped: SkillsToolset reads local directories and the workspace is inside a remote sandbox ... A text index the agent reads with read_file was chosen instead ... The ADR should be amended or this recorded as the interpretation.' The amendment is this session; the follow_up list carries the same item.

evidence.source: pydantic-ai-skills 1.3.0 (the locked dependency), verified against the installed package
evidence.detail: Its SkillsDirectory implementation is filesystem-only; the release offers no backend- or sandbox-aware directory. Against this pin the limitation's conclusion is correct: rooting a SkillsToolset at a remote-sandbox path would have required copying skills out of the sandbox.

evidence.source: pydantic-deep 0.3.43 (PyPI, released 2026-08-05, MIT; repository vstorm-co/pydantic-deepagents), source-verified
evidence.detail: BackendSkillsDirectory (pydantic_deep/features/skills/backend.py) roots a SkillsToolset at a backend path, discovers skills through BackendProtocol.glob_info, and executes skill scripts through SandboxProtocol.execute - precisely the backend-rooted, sandbox-executing skills surface the limitation presented as impossible.

Reasons: breaking changes land at patch level (0.3.32, a patch release, moved the required pydantic-ai major to 2.x); bus factor ~1 (a single maintainer authors ~86% of commits); its capabilities duck-type ctx.deps.backend and fail silently when the attribute is absent; BackendSkillsDirectory does synchronous discovery I/O in __init__, a poor fit for a per-turn toolkit over an HTTP RemoteSandbox; and ADR-006's Alternatives already reject depending on pydantic-deep wholesale, with the reconsider condition (a server mode) unmet.

proposed_action: Amend ADR-006 rule 5 in place (the ADR is still proposed, so no supersession): record the shipped read-only skills index as the standing interpretation, and name the backend-rooted skills directory - with in-sandbox script execution - as the priced upgrade path, carrying the deferral reasons above and the revisit trigger: skill execution inside workspaces becoming a requirement. That future work routes through the agent-tool workflow, is gated by agent-evals and security-review, and exact-pins (==) the dependency because of its patch-level breaking changes. Done in this session's diff. The 2026-08-23 change record itself stays untouched - history records are not edited; this evaluation is the correction mechanism.
